trigger: user instruction granting dependency freedom and supplying the official rules text
material_corrections: The local clause applying a 2026-07-05 publication cutoff to external DATA was stricter than the official rules and is withdrawn; data eligibility is per-row basis-time availability.
The 2026-07-05 cutoff correctly applies to PRETRAINED WEIGHTS only, together with a licence permitting use, modification, distribution, redistribution and commercial use.
The dependency freeze is withdrawn; BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY is no longer a valid standalone rejection.
Remote API model inference remains forbidden by rule 6; local weight loading is the only permitted execution mode.
